steps.step: M1.unique L0 ground state among all charge-neutral occupations is the Hardy sea {n<0}: one Fermi point; gaps are positive integers
steps.detail: 3432 occupations; extra Fermi points always cost energy

steps.step: M2.charge-zero excitation counts = p(h) = 1,1,2,3,5,7,11: the positive-energy Fock space is the level-one U(1) boson
M3.without orientation (non-chiral class) multi-Fermi-point seas are admissible (H3); with orientation + positive energy each chirality has one Fermi point: reflected double = 2 = K3
steps.detail: K3 is not an extra axiom once positive energy (already used by Moebius/BW) and the P1 orientation are accepted
